content.title: Netflix - AWS Cloud Strategy Discovery Meeting

transcript.speaker: Alex Carter
transcript.text: We are expanding our AWS footprint to support new AI and analytics workloads.

transcript.speaker: AccountPilot AE
transcript.text: Which AWS services are currently under evaluation?

transcript.speaker: Emily Davis
transcript.text: Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, Amazon EKS and AWS Security Hub are our primary focus areas.

transcript.speaker: Alex Carter
transcript.text: Our biggest concerns are governance, cloud costs, compliance and deployment timelines.

transcript.speaker: AccountPilot AE
transcript.text: We can prepare an architecture covering Bedrock integration, FinOps recommendations and security best practices.

transcript.speaker: Emily Davis
transcript.text: Please schedule a technical workshop and share pricing along with a phased migration roadmap.
